facts.fact: The Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026, signed 18 February 2026, designates the authority as lead national responder to cyber threats and requires it to establish a National Computer Incident Response Team Coordination Centre (SS-CIRT/CC).

Under Chapter V of the Act signed 18 February 2026, the minister may classify systems as critical infrastructure, and owners of designated systems must report any cybersecurity incident to the authority within 24 hours of detection.

systems.system: National Computer Incident Response Team Coordination Centre (SS-CIRT/CC)
systems.owner: designated authority under the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026
